title: Decision Tree vs. Linear Model:
prompt: **Decision Tree vs. Linear Model:** Which model performs better on the simple diagonal boundary $y = \mathbb{I}(x_1 + x_2 > 0)$? Why does an axis-aligned Decision Tree require a complex staircase approximation while Logistic Regression solves it with 2 parameters? Conversely, why does Logistic Regression fail on the XOR problem $y = \mathbb{I}(x_1 \cdot x_2 > 0)$ without an explicit interaction feature?
